playback.progression: Each movement video loops for the selected level count. After the final loop, a black Up Next screen displays the next movement and thumbnail for five seconds, then automatically starts it. Pause freezes playback or the transition timer; Resume continues; Next Movement can skip ahead. The final movement completes the selected level without changing difficulty.

levels.name: Beginner
levels.description: Seated foundations, gentle joint movement and steady support.

levels.name: Intermediate
levels.description: Seated mobility and flexibility with wider ranges and longer hinges.

levels.name: Advanced
levels.description: More involved hip positions, seated warrior shapes and supported standing balance.
